stem:
Lalit must construct rectangle $ABCD$ given side $DC = 5$ cm and diagonal $DB = 7$ cm.

Which plan locates vertex $B$ correctly?

options.text: Erect a perpendicular at $C$ without first drawing side $DC$ at its given length $5$ cm.
Locate $B$ by trial-and-error with a ruler only, without using a perpendicular and an arc.
Draw $DC$; erect a perpendicular to $DC$ at $C$; from $D$ draw an arc of radius $7$ cm; $B$ is their intersection.
Place $B$ using only the printed length $5$ cm, ignoring the diagonal length $7$ cm.

teacher.key_rationale: Vertex $B$ lies on the perpendicular to $DC$ at $C$ and on the circle centred at $D$ with radius equal to the diagonal. Skipping the given side, using ruler trial alone, or using only the printed $5$ cm, miss that locus.
